value.rationale: This determines the complete and sharp success/failure region for the smallest genuinely signed two-spike algebraic-moment recovery problem: degree two cannot interpolate two interior opposite extrema, degree three can precisely on an explicit nontrivial region. The exact 1/6 geometric success fraction, the asymmetry barrier \(|\mathrm{midpoint}|\le1/3\), and frontier uniqueness make a useful structural benchmark for low-degree moment recovery and spline-knot inference.
